head_commit.message:
[ipa-delivery:835] Build the private RewindBox IPA 835: DeSmuME asynchronous 3D and frames in the host's memory, with Azahar's per-frame images

Base: the verified IPA 834 (763908f0, run 45422937698). As the maintainer asked: this session's
DeSmuME work for 10x at 60 fps, and Azahar ("prend Azahar dans ton ipa"), nothing else.
- libretro collection LibretroCores-e5378e84 (run 45425936501, artifact 14939297496): desmume_libretro
  (asynchronous 3D, desmume_rb_3d_async auto by default; both screens written into the frontend's
  memory; [rb-perf] defer and direct) and azahar_libretro (one output image per libretro frame);
- libretro bridge: DeSmuME frames copied into their texture by the GPU from two shared Metal buffers;
  Vulkan images a core keeps per sync index lent straight to the presenter (Azahar).
Every other component as in the 834; the MoltenVK tenth part for MeloNX (3a18f778) stays source only.
Nothing measured on an iPhone.
